responsibility: Implements operations on chains of recurrences (CHRECs), GCC’s symbolic representation of scalar evolution in loops. It provides folding and algebra for polynomial recurrences, conversions between types, equality and direction tests, traversal helpers, and predicates for linearity and constant-step structure, supplying the arithmetic substrate used by scalar-evolution and loop-analysis code to reason about induction-variable evolution across nested loops.
same_name_distinction: Implements the CHREC operations declared in tree-chrec.h, providing the actual scalar-evolution folding, conversion, equality, direction, and traversal logic over polynomial recurrence trees.
